semantics: Firestore create trigger runs only after notificationOutbox commit.
Processor refuses delivery until the matching canonical workflowEvent exists.
Client portal projection uses deterministic event/client identity and merge semantics, so retries are idempotent.
Advisor/internal visibility remains the canonical notificationOutbox consumed by ops-advisor-inbox.
Unsupported external channels remain pending_connection; no email/WhatsApp provider delivery is simulated.
Processing failures persist retry_pending/failed_processing, attemptCount, retryEligible, lastError and nextAttemptAt.
Authenticated retry callable is explicit and scope-controlled.
